• WHOLE GRAIN FLAKES: Crunchy, tasty 100% whole grain wheat flakes contain 34g of whole grain per serving (at least 48g recommended daily); An ideal ready to eat pantry staple that the whole family can enjoy

  • VITAMINS AND MINERALS: Every serving provides 100% daily value of 11 vitamins and minerals as part of a balanced diet; Serve a bowl of cereal with milk or add some to cereal bars recipes as delicious snacks for adults or kids

  • GREAT START: This healthy cereal for adults is a great way to get Vitamin B12, Niacin, Iron, Pantothenic Acid, Riboflavin, Folic Acid, Vitamin B6, Zinc, Vitamin E, Thiamin, and Vitamin C

  • ON THE GO SNACKS: Toss some Total whole grain breakfast cereal into yogurt cups or trail mix recipes for crispy snacks on the go

  • CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Total Breakfast Cereal, 100% Daily Value of 11 Vitamins and Minerals, 16 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
features:
Features of Total Whole Grain Cereal

100% Whole Grain Wheat Flakes
Each serving is made entirely from whole grain wheat, offering a hearty and wholesome crunch.

Packed with Vitamins and Minerals
Delivers 100% of your daily recommended value of 11 essential vitamins and minerals, including vitamins A, C, D, E, B6, B12, calcium, and iron.

Low in Sugar and Fat
Contains only about 5 grams of sugar and less than 1 gram of fat per serving—perfect for those watching their intake.

Good Source of Fiber and Protein
Each serving offers about 3 grams of dietary fiber and 2–3 grams of protein, supporting digestive health and satiety.

Simple, Clean Ingredients
Free from artificial colors and flavors, with a natural, whole-grain base.

Kosher Certified & SNAP Eligible
Meets dietary standards for kosher consumers and is accessible through SNAP benefits.

Benefits of Total Cereal

Supports Heart and Gut Health
Rich in whole grains and fiber, which contribute to a healthy heart and digestive system.

Boosts Daily Nutrition Effortlessly
Makes it easy to meet your daily vitamin and mineral needs in just one bowl.

Energizing Breakfast Choice
Provides steady energy without a sugar crash, making it ideal for busy mornings.

Weight Management Friendly
Low in calories and fat, high in fiber—helps keep you full longer without unnecessary calories.

Great for All Ages
Nutritionally balanced for both adults and kids, with a mild taste that appeals to everyone.

Versatile Serving Options
Enjoy it with milk, sprinkle on yogurt, or mix into homemade snack bars and trail mix.
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Sugar, Honey, Salt. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Preserve Freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Vitamin E Acetate, Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), A B Vitamin (calcium pantothenate), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
